enum.name: MABUR_CAL_KIND
enum.description: Which calibration sweep a MABUR_CAL_SWEEP frame runs.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_KIND_VERIFY
entry.description: Verification pass at the walls found by a power sweep.

enum.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT
enum.description: Why MABUR_CAL_ACK accepted or refused a MABUR_CAL_SWEEP.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_ACCEPTED
entry.description: The drone will start the sweep.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_ANCHOR_UNREADABLE
entry.description: The drone has no readable calibration anchor.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_BUSY
entry.description: The drone is already running a sweep.

entry.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED
entry.description: The requested sweep is not supported by this drone build.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_SWEEP
message.description: Ground asks the drone to run a calibration sweep.
message.field: Session nonce; the drone echoes it on every reply for this sweep.
Frame sequence within the sweep, for duplicate/reorder detection.
Which sweep to run.
Channel bandwidth (MHz) the sweep flies at.
Frames transmitted per power/verify cell.
Settle time before sampling a cell, in milliseconds.
Gap between frames within a cell, in microseconds.
Dwell time per capacity point, in milliseconds.
Low end of the rel power index range swept.
High end of the rel power index range swept.
Bitmask of MCS indices the capacity sweep probes.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_ACK
message.description: Drone's reply to MABUR_CAL_SWEEP: accept, refuse, or report when the sweep will start.
message.field: Echoes the sweep's nonce.
Echoes the sweep's seq.
Accept/refuse result.
Milliseconds until the sweep starts, if accepted.
Stamp flag mask the drone will fly for this sweep.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_SWEEP_DONE
message.description: Drone reports a finished sweep's per-cell results.
message.field: Echoes the sweep's nonce.
Echoes the sweep's seq.
Frames offered per cell.
Blocked-frame percentage per cell.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_APPLY
message.description: Ground pushes the walls and efficiency table a sweep produced for the drone to adopt.
message.field: Session nonce for this apply.
Channel bandwidth (MHz) the table applies to.
Bitmask of which wall/efficiency slots are present.
Rel power-index wall per rung.
Legacy single wall index, kept for the reference unit.
air_clock efficiency per rung.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_APPLIED
message.description: Drone reports whether it adopted a MABUR_CAL_APPLY table.
message.field: Echoes the apply's nonce.
Echoes the bandwidth the apply targeted.
1 if the table was adopted, 0 otherwise.
Human-readable refusal reason, empty on success.

message.name: MABUR_CAL_ABORT
message.description: Ground cancels the in-progress sweep identified by nonce.
message.field: Nonce of the sweep to cancel.
